baselineDisplay.title: 露营遇上大暴雨
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】露营遇上大暴雨 （上）
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: What happened to the boys in the night?
问题：晚上这群男孩遭遇了什么？
Answer: It rained so heavily in the night that a stream formed right under the boys’ tent.
• 词汇准备
• tent 帐篷
• field 田地，田野
• smell 闻起来
• wonderful 极好的
• campfire 营火，篝火
• creep 爬行
• sleeping bag 睡袋
• comfortable 舒适的，安逸的
• soundly 香甜地
• leap 跳跃，跳起
• heavily 大量地
• stream 小溪
• form 形成
• wind 蜿蜒
• right 正好
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。
As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire. They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。他们全都饿了，饭菜散发出阵阵香味。
After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
他们美美地吃了一顿饭后，就围在营火旁讲起了故事，唱起了歌。
But some time later it began to rain. The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
但过了一阵子，天下起雨来，于是他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。
Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly. In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
睡袋既暖和又舒服，所以，他们都睡得很香。午夜前后，有两个孩子醒了，大声叫了起来。
The tent was full of water! They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
原来帐篷里到处都是水!他们全都跳出睡袋，跑到外面。
It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field. The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
雨下得很大，他们发现地上已经形成了一条小溪。那小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过去。
第二十四单元 【故事复现】露营遇上大暴雨 （下）
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Where did the boys put up their tent? What did they cook? (and)
2 What did they do after their meal? Did it begin to rain or not? Did they creep into their tent or not? (but...so)
3 Did the boys wake up in the middle of the night or not?
4 Was the tent full of water or not? Did they rush outside or did they stay in their tent? (so)
5 Where had a stream formed? Where did it flow? (and)
Answer: The boys put up their tent in the middle of a field and cooked a meal. After their meal they told stories and sang songs but it began to rain so they crept into their tent. The boys woke up in the middle of the night. The tent was full of water so they rushed outside. A stream had formed in the field and flowed right under their tent.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 The boys went to bed because ________.
(a) it was late
(b) they had sung songs
(c) it began to rain
(d) it had begun to rain and they felt tired
2 The boys _______.
(a) had a good night's sleep
(b) stayed in their tent all night
(c) had camped in the path of stream
(d) had camped beside stream
3 Where did they _________?
(a) it put up
(b) their tent put up
(c) put up it
(d) put their tent up
4 __________ this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
(a) As soon
(b) Just as
(c) Until
(d) Just after
5 They cooked a meal because ________.
(a) they had hunger
(b) they had hungry
(c) they were hunger
(d) they felt hungry
6 They sang songs by the campfire. They sang songs _______ the campfire.
(a) close
(b) near
(c) besides
(d) at
7 Where did the stream ________?
(a) flow
(b) flowed
(c) flew
(d) fly
8 They cooked a meal because they wanted to _______.
(a) sing songs
(b) tell stories
(c) play
(d) eat
9 The boys had put out the campfire. The fire wasn't _______.
(a) switched on
(b) on fire
(c) on
(d) alight
10 They crept into their tent, so they ________.
(a) made a lot of noise
(b) ran quickly
(c) were very quiet
(d) were very noisy
11 The boys slept comfortably. Their sleeping bags were ________.
(a) a comfort
(b) in comfort
(c) comfortable
(d) comfortably
12 They slept soundly. They slept ________.
(a) noisily
(b) fast
(c) deeply
(d) good

第二十四单元 【语法点拨】 副词的用法难点（上）
• 副词的分类
副词和副词短语的主要句法功能是作状语，可作定语、主语补语和宾语补语。作状语时不仅可以修饰动词、形容词、副词和介词短语，而且还可以修饰代词、限定词、名词短语或整个句子。
(1)程度副词(Adverbs of Degree)：修饰形容词、副词，表示程度。常见的有： very, much, so, too, quite, fairly, hardly, almost, nearly, altogether, half, barely, rather, extremely, somewhat 等
(2)频率副词(Adverbs of Frequency)：修饰动词，表示动作发生的频率。常见的有： always, often, usually, sometimes, seldom, generally, normally, hardly, rarely, scarcely, never, ever, frequently, occasionally 等。
(3)方式副词(Adverbs of Manner)：修饰动词，表示动作进行的方式。方式副词大多数以-ly 为结尾，常见的有:fast, slowly, carefully, suddenly, easily, quickly, swiftly quietly 等。
(4)时间副词(Adverbs of Time)：表示动作发生的时间。一些表示非确定时间的副词有: another day, another time, afterwards, already, at last, at once, early, eventually, formerly, immediately, just, lately, recently, now, nowadays, once, next day, presently, some day, soon, still, subsequently, suddenly, then, these days, ultimately, yet, ago, before 等。
(5)地点副词(Adverbs of Place)：表示动作发生的位置或方位。常见的有：here, there, above, below, away, far, abroad, up, down, downstairs, upstairs 等。
(6)焦点副词(Focus Adverbs): 用在所修饰的词之前，以使人对其集中注意。常见的有：even, just, merely, only, really, simply 等。
(7)句子副词或观点副词(Sentence Adverbs or Viewpoint Adverbs)：句子副词或观点副词又称为评述性副词，主要用来修饰整个句子，表示说话者或写作者的观点或态度。常见的有: frankly, obviously, clearly, generally, especially, typically, perhaps, maybe, yes, no 等。
(8)连接副词(Connective Adverbs)：修饰整个句子，表示该句与上下文的逻辑关系。 常见的有: however, nevertheless, nonetheless, therefore, thus, furthermore, moreover, evidently, hopefully, consequently, as a result 等。
▶ 某些副词的拼写形式
(1)容易拼写错的副词
gay-gaily
sly-slyly
happy-happily
noble-nobly
simple-simply
due-duly
rare-rarely
sole-solely
true-truly
whole-wholly
basic-basically
unique-uniquely
public-publicly
(2)形容词和副词都是以-ly 为结尾的词:
daily, deadly, early, fortnightly(每两周的/地, 两周一次的/地), hourly, kindly, leisurely(从容不迫的/地), likely, masterly(精巧的/地,巧妙的地), monthly, nightly, only, quarterly, weekly, yearly 等。
(3)有些以-ly 结尾的词不是副词而多是由名词加-ly 构成的形容词。因此，这类词在句中不能作状语。 常见的有: cowardly, fatherly motherly, brotherly, manly, womanly, heavenly, worldly, friendly, soldierly, stately, scholarly, lovely, silly, lively 等。例如:
• He treated me friendly. (friendly 应改为 in a friendly way)
▶ 某些副词的用法比较
▪ ago, before, since 的用法比较
(1)ago 表示从现在起推算到过去某一特定时刻或某一特定时期，因此与过去时态动词连用。
• More than thirty years ago, this city was a big farm.
三十多年以前，这座城市是一个大农场。
• There were lots of buffaloes in the North America 100 years ago.
100 年前，北美有大量的野牛。
(2)before 表示不确定时间，常与完成时态连用。直接引语用 ago，在间接引语里就得用 before。
• Have you seen the film before? 你以前看过这部影片吗?
• Tom told me that he had visited Shanghai before.
汤姆告诉我他以前到过上海。
(3)since 或 ever since 常与完成时态连用，表示从过去某一特定时刻延续到现在，谓语动词用现在完成时。
• She left four years ago and has not been seen since then.
她四年前就离开了，从那以后就没有见过她。
• Mary came to China two years ago and has lived here ever since.
玛丽两年前来到中国，从那时以来就一直生活在这里。
如果是表示介于过去某一时刻到过去另一特定时刻，则谓语动词用过去完成时。
• She had left four years before and had not been seen since then.
她是四年前离开的，从此后就没有见到她了。

第二十四单元 【语法点拨】 副词的用法难点（上）
• 副词的分类
副词和副词短语的主要句法功能是作状语，可作定语、主语补语和宾语补语。作状语时不仅可以修饰动词、形容词、副词和介词短语，而且还可以修饰代词、限定词、名词短语或整个句子。
(1)程度副词(Adverbs of Degree)：修饰形容词、副词，表示程度。常见的有： very, much, so, too, quite, fairly, hardly, almost, nearly, altogether, half, barely, rather, extremely, somewhat 等
(2)频率副词(Adverbs of Frequency)：修饰动词，表示动作发生的频率。常见的有： always, often, usually, sometimes, seldom, generally, normally, hardly ever, rarely, scarcely ever, never, ever, frequently, occasionally 等。
(3)方式副词(Adverbs of Manner)：修饰动词，表示动作进行的方式。方式副词大多数以-ly 为结尾，常见的有:fast, slowly, carefully, suddenly, easily, quickly, swiftly, quietly 等。
(4)时间副词及时间状语短语：表示动作发生的时间。常见表达有: another day, another time, afterwards, already, at last, at once, early, eventually, formerly, immediately, just, lately, recently, now, nowadays, once, next day, presently, some day, soon, still, subsequently, suddenly, then, these days, ultimately, yet, ago, before 等。
(5)地点副词(Adverbs of Place)：表示动作发生的位置或方位。常见的有：here, there, above, below, away, far, abroad, up, down, downstairs, upstairs 等。
(6)焦点副词（Focus Adverbs）：突出某个成分，如 even、just、merely、only、simply 等。位置需结合所强调的内容及句子结构判断，不一定紧挨在被强调的词之前。
(7)评述或观点副词可对整个句子表达说话者的评价、态度或判断，如 frankly、obviously、clearly、personally、perhaps、maybe 等。yes、no 常用作简短回应，不能直接当作这类修饰全句的典型例子。
(8)连接副词（Linking Adverbs）及连接性短语表示分句或句子之间的逻辑关系，如 however、nevertheless、nonetheless、therefore、thus、furthermore、moreover、consequently、as a result 等。evidently、hopefully 等主要表达判断或态度，不宜全归为连接副词。
▶ 某些副词的拼写形式
(1)容易拼写错的副词

rare-rarely
sole-solely
true-truly
whole-wholly
basic-basically
unique-uniquely
public-publicly
(2)形容词和副词都是以-ly 为结尾的词:
daily, deadly, early, fortnightly(每两周的/地, 两周一次的/地), hourly, kindly, leisurely(从容不迫的/地), likely, masterly(精巧的/地,巧妙地), monthly, nightly, only, quarterly, weekly, yearly 等。
(3)有些以 -ly 结尾的词主要是形容词，不能见到 -ly 就认定是副词，如 cowardly、fatherly、motherly、brotherly、manly、womanly、heavenly、worldly、friendly、soldierly、stately、scholarly、lovely、silly、lively 等。标准学习表达中，表示方式常改用相应短语，例如：
• He treated me in a friendly way. 他以友好的方式对待我。
▶ 某些副词的用法比较
▪ ago, before, since 的用法比较
(1)ago 通常从现在回溯某个时间距离，常与一般过去时连用，如 thirty years ago。
• More than thirty years ago, this city was a big farm.
三十多年以前，这座城市是一个大农场。
• There were lots of buffaloes in North America 100 years ago.
100 年前，北美有大量的野牛。
(2)before 作副词可表示“以前”，也可配合时间距离回溯某个参照时刻，如 four years before。转述过去的话时，若参照点改变，ago 常改为 before/earlier；不能说所有间接引语中都必须这样替换。
• Have you seen the film before? 你以前看过这部影片吗?
• Tom told me that he had visited Shanghai before.
汤姆告诉我他以前到过上海。
(3)since 或 ever since 常与完成时态连用，表示从过去某一特定时刻延续到现在，谓语动词用现在完成时。
• She left four years ago and has not been seen since then.
她四年前就离开了，从那以后就没有见过她。
• Mary came to China two years ago and has lived here ever since.
玛丽两年前来到中国，从那时以来就一直生活在这里。
如果是表示介于过去某一时刻到过去另一特定时刻，则谓语动词用过去完成时。
• She had left four years before and had not been seen since then.
她是四年前离开的，从此后就没有见到她了。

blocks.text: 【故事复现】露营遇上大暴雨 （上）

• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。

Question: What happened to the boys in the night?
问题：晚上这群男孩遭遇了什么？
Answer: It rained so heavily in the night that a stream formed right under the boys’ tent.
• 词汇准备

• field 田地，田野
• smell 闻起来

• creep 爬行
• sleeping bag 睡袋
• comfortable 舒适的，安逸的
• soundly 香甜地
• leap 跳跃，跳起
• heavily 大量地
• stream 小溪
• form 形成
• wind 蜿蜒
• right 正好

• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire. They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。他们全都饿了，饭菜散发出阵阵香味。

After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
他们美美地吃了一顿饭后，就围在营火旁讲起了故事，唱起了歌。

But some time later it began to rain. The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
但过了一阵子，天下起雨来，孩子们也感到累了，于是他们扑灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。

Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly. In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
睡袋既暖和又舒服，所以，他们都睡得很香。午夜前后，有两个孩子醒了，大声叫了起来。

The tent was full of water! They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
原来帐篷里到处都是水!他们全都跳出睡袋，跑到外面。

It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field. The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
雨下得很大，他们发现地上已经形成了一条小溪。那小溪弯弯曲曲穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷底下流过去。

3 Did the boys wake up in the middle of the night or not?
4 Was the tent full of water or not? Did they rush outside or did they stay in their tent? (so)

The boys woke up in the middle of the night. The tent was full of water so they rushed outside. A stream had formed in the field and flowed right under their tent.
